# EIDL Loan Forgiveness Portal [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Is the EIDL loan forgiveness portal real? EIDL loan forgiveness options 2026, SBA hardship accommodation under 13 CFR 123.602, offer in compromise tracks

## About
eidlloanforgiveness.com is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
